notes_en: At Shichahai-Yuhe, morning: the water gates carry the memory of grain tribute barges. What arrives, what leaves, where transfer occurs, what changes.
notes_zh: 后海—御河,清晨:水闸仍承载着漕运粮船的集体记忆。何来、何去、何处中转、何者改变。
tags: 运河, 粮食, 什刹海

title_en: When the past grows new life
notes_en: Gamla Skogsby, Iron Age site: soil, plants and food are being used to ask whether the past can generate future life.
notes_zh: Gamla Skogsby 铁器时代遗址:以土壤、植物与食物追问——过去能否生长出未来的生命。
tags: 再生, 厄兰岛, 铁器时代

notes_en: Tongzhou, dawn: joggers and yangge troupes move along the Grand Canal park while a museum recreates the 1920s towpath. The canal lives twice - as daily amenity and as displayed heritage.
notes_zh: 通州,拂晓:晨跑者与秧歌队沿着大运河公园移动,博物馆则在重建 1920 年代的纤道。运河被双重活化——既是日常设施,又是被展出的遗产。
tags: 通州, 活态遗产, 博物馆, 日常生活

title_en: Porridge at the old grain wharf
notes_en: Zhangjiawan, the historic tribute-grain wharf: the quay keeps its old alignment while the waterside market opens for breakfast; porridge vendors work the morning crowd where barges once tied up.
notes_zh: 张家湾,漕运古码头:码头仍保持旧时走向,而近水早市已开张;粥摊在当年粮船停靠的人群中营业。
tags: 张家湾, 漕粮, 码头, 早市

notes_en: The Qingcheng lock gate (upper lock) is preserved within the modern city grid; the canal beneath the street map is lined with re-created heritage. Living heritage here is staged between daily life and display.
notes_zh: 澄清上闸被保留在现代城市网格之内;街图之下的运河两岸排列着再造的遗产。此间的活态遗产,在日常生活与展示之间被演出。
tags: 北京大运河, 澄清闸, 遗产化

notes_en: Visby, a loop of the town wall: thirteenth-century ramparts now buffer hotels and tour buses; the wall is kept authentic while the life behind it is re-invented for tourism.
notes_zh: 维斯比,沿城墙环行:十三世纪城墙如今缓冲着酒店与旅游大巴;城墙被保持原真,其背后的生活却在为旅游业被重新发明。
tags: 维斯比, 城墙, 原真性, 旅游

notes_en: Frojel harbour, from which Viking-Age goods once shipped out: the same bay now lands herring sold straight at the quayside; one catch at a time, the food corridor comes ashore.
notes_zh: 弗勒耶尔港,维京时代曾从这里运出货物:如今同一处海湾的鲱鱼在码头边直售;一船一船,食物廊道登岸了。
tags: 里丹纳斯, 鲱鱼, 码头直售, 食物廊道

title_en: From kitchen floor to future grain
notes_en: Gamla Skogsby, on the 2021-season kitchen assemblage: pig bones, quern stones and pottery read as the record of a chieftain household; soil carried out of the floors is being re-sown with heritage cereals.
notes_zh: Gamla Skogsby,就 2021 季厨房遗存而言:猪骨、磨石与陶器被解读为一个首领之家的记录;从灶台下取出的土壤正被重新种上传统谷物。
tags: Gamla Skogsby, 厨房, 宴饮, 再生

notes_en: Nykvarn lock, Lake Roxen: the lock keeper now doubles as guide, freight barges carry day-trippers, and the national-interest designation preserves the 1871 waterway as cultural scenery.
notes_zh: Nykvarn 闸,罗森湖:闸门管理员兼任导游,货驳载着观光客,国家利益保护把这条 1871 年的水道保存为文化风景。
tags: 金达运河, Nykvarn 闸, 国家利益, 旅游
